infotexts.entitydescription.descendantservosuit: A 10,000 m pressure suit with an autonomous third arm. Select one function: blue repair/welding, red defense or orange tractor beam. Aim and use to acquire a grab target; switch mode to release. Breathable air retracts the helmet and saves oxygen. Oxygen and battery/reactor rod occupy separate containers. LuaCs required.
infotexts.descendant.title: Servo arm
